_about: Winelingo's own facts, in the same shape as the apps in competitors.json. Checked 2026-11-10 against the live App Store listing (version 1.5.4), /pricing/ and /course/. Update this file when the app or the prices change, then run scripts/build-compare.mjs.
name: Winelingo
what_it_is: A wine-education app: short lessons and games that teach wine, plus a scanner that explains the bottle or wine list in front of you.
best_for: Learning wine from scratch, a few minutes a day, and understanding the bottle in front of you
platforms: Web (the course and the tests, in any browser)

price.free_tier: Every lesson in the iPhone app (with 5 hearts that refill), 5 label scans a month, the first two course units on the web, and all the practice tests
price.paid: Premium $3.99 a month, or $29.99 a year in the iPhone app (unlimited hearts and scans, the whole course on the web); or the course for life for $39.99 once on winelingo.app

feature_notes.ratings_reviews: An average once 3 people have rated a wine; no public reviews
feature_notes.quizzes_or_games: Plus practice tests for WSET and sommelier exams

scale: Launched August 2026; a new, small app
limits_or_tradeoffs: No Android app: on Android the course and the tests run in the browser, but scanning needs the iPhone app
A small wine database compared with apps that have collected ratings for over a decade
Very few ratings from other users and no public reviews, no prices, no shop and no cellar inventory
